art.title: First Landing of Christopher Columbus
art.why: The encounter itself, as Americans pictured it three centuries later. The look must note whose view this is and not exoticise; the description is neutral (two groups facing each other at the shore).

Agnolo degli Erri, 'A Dominican Preaching' (45949ade-9d91-45dd-875a-3e164f930351) is exactly right but already claimed by cathedrals-and-universities. Nothing else fits: null unless that journey releases it.

art.title: Saint Anthony of Padua
art.why: No friar portrait of Las Casas; a friar of the 1490s in his habit with a book. Las Casas was a Dominican, Anthony a Franciscan: say so.
No Paul III in the NGA (Titian's portrait is in Naples). Ingres's 'Pope Pius VII in the Sistine Chapel' is claimed by crusades. Null.
No Salamanca or university scene free in the cache. Null.

art.title: Chief Jumper of the Seminoles
art.why: A dignified, named Indigenous leader, painted as a person (head and shoulders, headwrap, sash, silver earring), not as a type; not Catlin. Check the gallery's notes on the sitter's name before use.

music.why: Psalm 51, the prayer of repentance: Las Casas's own conversion from slave-owner to defender.

flags: Needs a historian's review; sensitive subject; paintings must not exoticise (spec). Session 1's painting is an 1800 American celebration of the landing: the look must say whose picture it is.
Paul III, Salamanca and the Dominican preacher have no free NGA painting (the Dominican is claimed by cathedrals-and-universities).

Columbus (Major), Sublimis Deus (MacNutt) and Vitoria (Bate) are qualifying translations, but no online copy could be confirmed before the search budget ran out: gutendex searches are in the want file; archive.org identifiers still needed.
